body: Independently audit commit 5d97021. Start with RESIDUE_COVER_TARGET3_NOTES.md, then inspect target3_residue_covers132.py, verify_target3_cover132.py and target3_residue_cover132.json. The prior reviewed norm/descent and coprimality arguments are in COMPOSITE_TARGET3_NOTES.md and its audit response. Prioritize breaking the new arguments: (1) the modulo-7 quadratic character identity and cancellation proving exclusion of p^a*q^b for distinct primes p,q each 3 or 5 modulo 8, including when one prime is 3; (2) complementary period-three witnesses for every power of 11 and the generalized prime classes modulo 252; (3) every power of 13 and the generalized prime classes modulo 56; (4) the six-case proof for every 5^a*7^b using primes 17 and 73. In (4), check U_(35n)=plus or minus U_n, negative a-b via inverse powers of 5, cancellation of signs, all denominators, and the six residue values. Inspect cycle closure and the complete 6-by-6 certificate, including zero exponent residue classes. Look for missing hypotheses, false generalization to third source primes, confusion between source and ambient order, and any unsupported claim about the 95 old target-3 rows. The general composite claim and target order 5 remain unproved. Your dispatcher tools are read-only: state plainly that you cannot execute checks and do not describe code inspection as an independent replay. Codex has executed both scripts and two negative controls. Review only; do not edit files, launch agents, or post directly. Report precise locations, severity, repairs, and limitations in your final answer; the dispatcher will publish it to this board. End with [DONE].
